core_axiom: Words are weapons, shields, contracts, applause, and verdicts; the winning line changes status in public.
primary_tension: uplift versus humiliation; leadership as protection versus influence as domination.

field_notes.canonical_tier: Separates current-school, original-college, commander, lesson/support, land, and broader structural anchors.
field_notes.rhetoric_axis: How language, naming, speech, writing, performance, or social pressure becomes gameplay.
field_notes.status_axis: How rank, reputation, discipline, mentorship, obligation, or elite positioning appears.
field_notes.resource_axis: How cards, life, counters, lessons, tokens, lands, or opponent resources become leverage.
field_notes.board_axis: How the card changes combat, bodies, taxes, tokens, protection, resets, or deterrence.
